observations.detail: RSO-DISC-003 red-team categories materially expanded candidate capture beyond headline setting-summary items; rare direct-hit, return, prescribed-count and state-dependent candidates were retained.
RSO-DISC-001/003 remain BLOCKED in the Compliance Ledger instead of being declared PASS from an initialized artifact alone.
Discovery trace stores candidates without adoption/rejection dispositions, including very rare events such as Super Rio Ace 2 direct Bonus.

SloPla NEXT exposes many machine-specific fields publicly and is highly auditable. UniMemo confirms BIRDIE WING support and general result/interim-record functions but machine-specific field list remains unresolved from public pages. SAO II Daitomo machine-specific field list also remains unresolved from public pages.

If RSO-OBS-004 is interpreted as requiring a complete public machine-specific field list before Gate 0, services that expose exact fields only on-device/app may cause excessive MANUAL_BLOCK. Do not relax this Batch; record whether Observation Gate is a better enforcement point after field test.

The legacy requirement to terminally classify every discovery category as FOUND/CHECKED_NONE/UNRESOLVED is proving useful and may deserve explicit normative wording rather than relying on appendix knowledge.
